architecture: A module-based architecture using a main game loop driven by `requestAnimationFrame`. Game states (Loading, Menu, Playing, Paused, GameOver) are managed by a central `Game` object. Rendering utilizes WebGL via Three.js. Input is processed via a dedicated `InputManager` for touch-based controls. Game logic is distributed across specialized modules for player, enemies, collisions, UI, assets, and sound.

art_prompts.background: Low-poly 3D industrial factory arena, metallic walls, grated floors, sci-fi pipes, dark ambiance, glowing accents, mobile game aesthetic.
art_prompts.player: Low-poly 3D futuristic energy weapon model, visible in first-person, sleek design, glowing barrel, metallic texture, mobile game aesthetic.
art_prompts.enemy: Low-poly 3D malfunctioning factory robot, humanoid shape, metallic, glowing red eyes, rusted and damaged parts, distinct idle, move, attack, and death stances, mobile game enemy.
art_prompts.ui_button: Sci-fi industrial touch button for mobile game, metallic, glowing edges, circular shape for joystick, rectangular for shoot, clear icon, user-friendly FPS controls.

file_structure.index.html: Main HTML file, sets up the canvas and base UI containers.
file_structure.style.css: CSS for basic layout, font imports, and UI styling.
file_structure.js/game.js: Main game logic, orchestrates the game loop, states, and module interactions.
file_structure.js/modules/Renderer.js: Handles WebGL rendering using Three.js, manages camera, scene, and render pass.
file_structure.js/modules/InputManager.js: Processes touch inputs for virtual joystick movement, camera aiming, and shooting.
file_structure.js/modules/Player.js: Manages player character logic, including movement, health, weapon state, and actions.
file_structure.js/modules/EnemyManager.js: Responsible for spawning, updating AI, and managing the lifecycle of enemy robots.
file_structure.js/modules/CollisionDetector.js: Implements Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) collision detection for all game entities.
file_structure.js/modules/UIManager.js: Draws and updates on-screen UI elements like health bar, ammo counter, score, and game state messages.
file_structure.js/modules/AssetLoader.js: Loads and caches all 3D models, textures, sounds, and other game assets.
file_structure.js/modules/SoundManager.js: Manages playback of sound effects and background music.
file_structure.js/modules/Physics.js: Provides lightweight physics calculations for projectile movement and simple environmental interactions.
file_structure.js/lib/three.min.js: Minified core Three.js library for 3D graphics.
file_structure.js/lib/GLTFLoader.js: Three.js module for loading GLTF 3D model files.
